## Checklist

- [ ] Tests for the change (a bugfix needs a regression test, named after the issue if there is one)
- [ ] An entry in `CHANGELOG.rst`, if the change is user-visible
- [ ] `uv run tox -e default,typecheck,lint` passes
- [ ] The behavior matches the stdlib's `ConfigParser`, or the deviation is documented
